Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses an AP-MS approach to identify ZUFSP interactors. While the paper discusses ubiquitin and DUB activity extensively, the mass spectrometry part described for the PRIDE dataset (PXD008509) is a standard AP-MS interactome study using LFQ and spectral counting, not a PTM-enrichment (diGly/QQTGG) proteomics run.

scope: Immunoprecipitation for MS analyses 5μg of anti-ZUFSP antibody or anti-rabbit IgG antibody was conjugated to around 10 μl of magnetic beads (Bio-Rad) for 1 h at 4°C in PBS.
Subsequently 20 mg of precleared lysate was used per immunoprecipitation (IP) with the ZUFSP antibody.
Proteins were eluted with 120 mM glycine pH 2 (3 time/5 min/30 μl).
